title: Theory: non-humans seed and genetically adjust life, returning every thousand years with agriculture, metallurgy and language

tellings.quote: then every thousand years pop back and introduce agriculture or irrigation systems or metallurgy or religion

plain: Chris Ramsay, a guest on host Jesse Michels's podcast in 2025, lays out a theory that non-human beings seed life on planets and adjust it genetically. He suggests they then return every thousand years or so to introduce things like agriculture, irrigation, metal-working or religion, which would mean human progress has been guided from outside.
